name: short-read sequencing accuracy benchmark (Mycobacterium tuberculosis)
description: Measures empirical base-level and variant-calling accuracy of short-read sequencing across the M. tuberculosis genome to identify systematic errors and performance variation by region.
evaluation_method: precision/recall/F1 (for variant calls) and base-level accuracy/error rate
general_score_metric: F1 for variant calls (and base-level error rate)
reputation: Used by genomics and bioinformatics tool developers to quantify short-read sequencing and variant-calling performance for M. tuberculosis; respected within niche sequencing QA communities.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on a single organism; results depend heavily on the quality of the truth set, regional genome variation, and may not generalize to other species or to long-read technologies.
